name: odm-poser-dev
description: Tools for working on the editor and the site. version: the editor's version (shown in its header; the next release, tagged v<version>, see CHANGELOG.md). Astro makes the pages (src/pages: the editor, the docs, the site root); web/ goes out as it is (Astro's publicDir: the editor's scripts, styles and pictures). Tailwind CSS makes web/editor/ui.css from web/editor/ui.src.css (commit both); melta-lint checks the UI against melta UI (design/melta-ui). cookie 2 is listed so that it, not the cookie 0.7 of melta-ds-mcp's express, sits at the top of node_modules, where Astro's build looks for it.
